title: A parlamentáris demokrácia és az államszervezet (State Structure & Parliamentary Democracy)
grammar: Constitutional Guarantees, Supranational Integration & Kin-State Registers in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name the main state bodies: the National Assembly, the President and the Government.
I can say who elects the Prime Minister and how often parliament is elected.
I can say what a local government and a referendum are.
I can use the words of this lesson about the state and parliament.
